The present case pertains to offence punishable under Sections 376/342/323/506/451/120B of IPC and the learned appearing on behalf of respondent nos. 2 to 4, who appears through video conferencing, wants to argue the case.
However, the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner seeks adjournment on the ground of non-availability of the main counsel.
2. It is noticed by this Court that in sexual assault cases, counsels are appearing through video conferencing in a routine manner alongwith the complainant/victims also.
Since as per law, the identity of the complainant/victim cannot be disclosed publically.
